name: Proclus
bio: Proclus was the leading Neoplatonic philosopher of the fifth century AD. Paton's Index of Authors includes the poet among those of Book VII. Paton's index of authors dates the poet to 5th century AD.
This archive carries the 1 epigram ascribed to the poet in the second volume of W. R. Paton's prose translation (Book VII: 341).

poems.title: Book VII, 341
poems.author: Proclus
poems.text: I am Proclus of Lycia, whom Syrianus educated here to be his successor in the school. This our common tomb received the bodies of both, and would that one place might receive our spirits too.
